column1: # Traditional Chinese (zh-hant) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); Chinese has one form, so
#                                 the translation is a single string (see `plural` in i18n.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using the
# vector-drawing vocabulary in everyday use in Taiwan (錨點, 路徑, 筆畫, 填色, 工作區域, 路徑管理員 ...).
# No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; add
# entries the same way. Product and technology names (VectorCraft, ArtCraft, SVG, OpenType, CMYK,
# Lab ...) and paper sizes (Letter, Tabloid) stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog
# commands is kept. Full-width punctuation (，。：) inside sentences; half-width parentheses and
# the " · " separators as in the English. Terms shared with PhotoCraft use the same words as its
